raw:
I remember feeling sad when my father missed my school play. His train was delayed by snow, so he couldn’t get there. I’d saved a program for him because I wanted him to have it, and I’d really wanted him to see the play.

I knew the delay wasn’t his fault, but I was still disappointed. The program was something I’d been looking forward to giving him, and then he wasn’t there. Knowing why he’d missed it didn’t quite take away the sadness.
